results.name: Share with invalid email format
results.expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Invalid request data."}

results.name: Share with non-existent Rootline user
results.expected: HTTP 404 Not Found ('That user does not have a Rootline account.')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"That user does not have a Rootline account."}

results.name: Unauthorized sharing by non-owner (User B on User A tree)
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Only the tree owner can perform this action')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"You do not have access to this family tree"}

results.name: Unauthorized sharing by unauthenticated client
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Could not validate credentials"}

results.name: Sharing tree with oneself (owner)
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request ('You already own this family tree.')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"You already own this family tree."}

results.name: User A shares tree with User B as Viewer via API
results.expected: HTTP 201 Created

results.name: User B (Viewer) opens shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK (role='viewer')
results.notes: Name: Updated Seed Tree, PeopleCount: 117

results.name: User B (Viewer) views people list of shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with people records
results.notes: Found 117 people

results.name: User B (Viewer) attempting to edit a person
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Viewers cannot modify this family tree')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Viewers cannot modify this family tree"}

results.name: User B (Viewer) attempting to rename tree
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Only the tree owner can perform this action')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Only the tree owner can perform this action"}

results.name: User B (Viewer) attempting to add a person to shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Viewers cannot modify this family tree')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Viewers cannot modify this family tree"}

results.name: User B (Viewer) attempting to delete a person from shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Viewers cannot modify this family tree')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Viewers cannot modify this family tree"}

results.name: User B (Viewer) attempting to link people in shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Viewers cannot modify this family tree')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Viewers cannot modify this family tree"}

results.name: User B (Viewer) attempting to unlink relationships in shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Not Found"}

results.name: User B attempting to promote self to Editor
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Only the tree owner can perform this action')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Only the tree owner can perform this action"} (503 if SQL operator mismatch occurs)

results.name: User B tree view reflects Editor role
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK (role='editor')
results.notes: Role: editor

results.name: User B (Editor) edits allowed person data in shared tree
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with updated field
results.notes: Updated occupation: Genealogist-1789755637

results.name: User A (Owner) sees the edits made by User B
results.expected: Occupation matches 'Genealogist-1789755637'
results.notes: Confirmed synchronized data for owner

results.name: User B (Editor) attempting owner-only tree rename
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Only the tree owner can perform this action')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Only the tree owner can perform this action"}

results.name: User B (Editor) attempting owner-only collaborator sharing
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Only the tree owner can perform this action')
results.notes: Response: {"detail":"Only the tree owner can perform this action"}

results.name: User B blocked from editing after removal
